Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a single full-body character cutout for one column in a 5-day PPLUL workout infographic. Generate a NEW drawing from the two official reference images. Image 1 is the authoritative face and black sunglasses reference; Image 2 is the authoritative body, clothing, proportions, outline and shading reference. Exactly ONE character, ONE static pose, full body from head to shoes, centered, no equipment, no text, no labels, no borders. Keep the exact extremely muscular exaggerated proportions, bald head, featureless mouthless face, almost invisible nose and ears, crisp black sunglasses, black shorts and black sneakers. Unshadowed skin surfaces must use #DDD6D2; highlighted muscle surfaces must use #E5725C. Keep subtle shallow shading close to these base colors, thin clean outlines, gentle anatomical internal lines. No white highlights, deep shadows, gray overall tint, veins, striations or photoreal muscle fibers. Highlight muscle bellies cleanly following anatomical boundaries, no glow or heatmap; keep all inactive skin beige. Truly transparent background, no shadows outside the silhouette. Hands with five natural fingers, arms relaxed slightly away from torso, balanced stance, entire figure uncropped with a little margin.
Straight FRONT view. Highlight BOTH pectorals, anterior and lateral deltoids, and triceps where visible. Keep biceps, abs, forearms, neck, hands, and all legs beige.
